principle: Harvest the complete candidate universe, but fit one provenance-closed family at a time; no all-at-once global optimization is authorized.

selection.pht_cut: |P_hT| < min[min(0.2 Q, 0.5 z Q)+0.3 GeV, z Q]

blocking_evidence: The available HERMES HEPData projection has 288 rows and lacks the Q/x axes required for the published post-cut selection.
The HERMES supplemental value and covariance archive has not yet been mirrored.
COMPASS HEPData contains 4664 primary rows; representative bin choices produce 1078--1285 candidates rather than certifying 1203.

stages.name: all-public-candidates
stages.purpose: Build a complete public-source registry, preserve hashes and raw provenance, and classify each observable before fitting.
stages.exit_gate: registry, source hashes, table inventory, and explicit stage/diagnostic/deferred classification

stages.name: HERMES-COMPASS-1547-benchmark
stages.purpose: Reproduce the external clean HERMES/COMPASS checkpoint before adding any new experiment.
stages.entry_gate: HERMES zxpt-3D value/covariance files and COMPASS row-level selection convention are available.
required_closure: Q, x, z, W2, y, P_hT or P_hT2 bin integration
stages.fit_protocol: fit HERMES and COMPASS separately, then combined; retain leave-one-family-out and held-out-bin predictions

stages.name: clean-HERMES-COMPASS-extensions
stages.purpose: Test additional public HERMES/COMPASS multiplicity projections after overlap and convention closure.
stages.entry_gate: S1 promoted and each extension has a row-selection and covariance manifest.
stages.fit_protocol: one source/hadron/target block per trial; warm start from S1 only after an independent-start check

stages.name: CLAS-absolute-cross-section
stages.purpose: Test a proton absolute-cross-section family and its radiative/acceptance conventions without silently converting it to a multiplicity.
stages.entry_gate: S1 interface reproduces DY and SIDIS scalar references; CLAS five-fold cross-section, radiative factor, bin integration, and covariance are closed.
stages.fit_protocol: pi+ first; Q2/x/z slices held out by construction; compare absolute normalization and shape separately

stages.name: Hall-C-low-energy
stages.purpose: Assess low-energy H/D pi cross sections only after W/Mx, rho subtraction, hadron-mass, and low-Q factorization checks.
stages.entry_gate: CLAS or an equivalent absolute-cross-section closure passes and low-energy validity is documented.
stages.fit_protocol: H and D, then charge blocks; leave-one-kinematic-bin-out and normalization-nuisance tests

stages.name: recent-and-historical-complements
stages.purpose: Add kaon, recent hydrogen, EMC, and E665 families one at a time after observable and current-fragmentation closure.
stages.entry_gate: The source is shown to share the declared SIDIS observable and its target/energy corrections are explicit.
stages.fit_protocol: source-by-source; report incremental chi-square, central shift, start spread, and held-out performance

stages.name: nuclear-current-region-diagnostics
stages.purpose: Use nuclear, jet/remnant, Breit-frame, and current-region data as falsification/diagnostic tests unless their dedicated formalism closes.
stages.entry_gate: Dedicated nuclear/current-region/jet observable and covariance implementations pass independent closure.
stages.fit_protocol: never merge diagnostically by default; report prediction-only residuals and failure modes

stages.name: future-or-access-restricted
stages.purpose: Keep public pointers visible without treating proposals or access-restricted databases as harvested fit data.
stages.entry_gate: A final, versioned, publicly reproducible table and uncertainty definition becomes available.
stages.fit_protocol: re-enter through S0 inventory and source-specific closure; never infer rows from a pointer
